Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: For many people, discovering everything Tanzania offers is a dream. Tanzania has it all: thrilling safaris in search of Africa’s Big Five, a climb up Kilimanjaro, or time to unwind on the beautiful beaches of Zanzibar. The good news is that Your Tanzania Trip can put together a custom made itinerary that matches all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?

blocks.html: We are happy to help, whether you go for one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or would rather adapt the journey to your own plans. Join us and get ready to discover Tanzania at your own pace, just the way you want!

blocks.orig: As you walk out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide greets you with a big smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' The guide takes you straight to your hotel, where you can relax and take in the African atmosphere. The next day your guide takes you on an exclusive, private safari that allows you to travel at your own pace. Enjoy the luxury of your own safari jeep and take the liberty to stop and watch the animals as long as you like!
blocks.html: When you step out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide is waiting with a broad smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' You are driven directly to your hotel, where you can unwind and soak up the African atmosphere. The following day your guide sets off with you on an exclusive, private safari, so you can travel at the pace that suits you. You have your own safari jeep, and you are free to stop and watch the animals for as long as you want.

blocks.orig: Mkomazi National Park is 3200 square kilometers in size and lies in the north of Tanzania, close to Moshi and the border with Kenya. Together with Kenya's Tsavo National Park, it provides a base for migratory herds of elephants, oryx and zebras during the rainy season. Visitors cannot miss the Mbula Rhino Sanctuary where rhinos might come close to the car! During regular game drives, you usually encounter animals such as giraffes, antelopes, buffalos, lions, leopards and many more.
blocks.html: Covering 3200 square kilometers, Mkomazi National Park is located in northern Tanzania, near Moshi and the Kenyan border. In the rainy season, it serves as a base for migrating herds of elephants, oryx and zebras, together with Kenya's Tsavo National Park. A visit to the Mbula Rhino Sanctuary is a must, as rhinos may come close to the car! On ordinary game drives you will usually see animals such as giraffes, antelopes, buffalos, lions, leopards and many others.

blocks.orig: The Mbula Rhino Sanctuary lies within the boundaries of Mkomazi National Park, where it is home to over 35 rhinos, and their numbers are growing. The rhinos were reintroduced to Mkomazi in the 1990s and visitors can enter the sanctuary in an open safari vehicle of the national park, together with a ranger. This ranger knows precisely where the rhinos are and will do his best to arrange an encounter. Don't be surprised if these majestic animals walk straight to your car!
blocks.html: Inside the boundaries of Mkomazi National Park you find the Mbula Rhino Sanctuary, where more than 35 rhinos live and their number keeps increasing. Rhinos were brought back to Mkomazi in the 1990s, and you can visit the sanctuary with a ranger in one of the national park's open safari vehicles. The ranger knows exactly where the rhinos are and does all he can to give you an encounter. Do not be surprised if these impressive animals walk right up to your car!

blocks.orig: The Usambara Mountains are a lush green mountain range south of Mkomazi National Park, with a cool climate that is ideal for hikes. Walks take you over sweeping hills, along waterfalls, farmland, plantations, picturesque villages and colourful markets, with the most amazing views almost everywhere you go. During the hike with a guide, you will see all sorts of flowers, butterflies, chameleons, and fruit trees and enjoy the view over the outstretched plains just beyond these mountains. You sleep in one of the area's highest hotels: Mambo View Point.
blocks.html: South of Mkomazi National Park rise the Usambara Mountains, a lush green range with a cool climate that is perfect for hiking. The walks lead you across rolling hills, past waterfalls, farmland, plantations, charming villages and colourful markets, with wonderful views nearly everywhere. On the guided hike you see all kinds of flowers, butterflies, chameleons and fruit trees, and you can enjoy the view across the wide plains just beyond the mountains. You spend the night at Mambo View Point, one of the highest hotels in the area.

blocks.orig: The Magoroto Forest Estate lies 850 meters above sea level and is part of the Eastern Usambara Mountains. It’s known for its beautiful campground near an amazingly still freshwater lake surrounded by dense tropical rainforests. On your first day, you hike along one of Magoroto’s hiking trails to the waterfalls. The day after you entertain yourself with activities such as boat rides, swimming, fishing, bird watching, hiking, horse riding, or mountain biking!
blocks.html: At 850 meters above sea level, the Magoroto Forest Estate is part of the Eastern Usambara Mountains. It is known for its lovely campground beside a remarkably still freshwater lake, surrounded by dense tropical rainforest. On the first day you walk one of Magoroto’s hiking trails to the waterfalls. The next day you can keep busy with boat rides, swimming, fishing, bird watching, hiking, horse riding or mountain biking!

blocks.orig: Saadani National Park is a small national park on the coast between Dar es Salaam and Tanga. It's the only national park on the coast of East Africa and the only place where you go on safari during the day, only to relax in a tropical beach setting afterward. Spot waterbucks, gazelles, giraffes, warthogs, hippos, crocodiles, baboons, and, with a bit more luck, elephants, lions, and leopards during the safari by car, on foot, or by boat!
blocks.html: On the coast between Dar es Salaam and Tanga lies Saadani National Park, a small national park. It is the only coastal national park in East Africa, and the only place where you can go on safari by day and then relax in a tropical beach setting. During the safari by car, on foot or by boat, look out for waterbucks, gazelles, giraffes, warthogs, hippos, crocodiles and baboons, and, if you are a little luckier, elephants, lions and leopards!

blocks.orig: The last day! Enjoy the final moments of your holiday before heading to Julius Nyerere International Airport in Dar Es Salaam for your flight home. Having second thoughts? Extending your holiday to paradise islands, such as Zanzibar, Pemba, or Mafia is also possible!
blocks.html: Your final day! Make the most of the last moments of your holiday before you travel to Julius Nyerere International Airport in Dar Es Salaam for your flight home. Not ready to leave yet? You can also extend your holiday on paradise islands, such as Zanzibar, Pemba or Mafia!
